Count duplicate values by column pair

Source: R/duplicate-count-colpair.R
duplicate_count_colpair.Rd

duplicate_count_colpair() counts, for every pair of columns in a data frame, the values that occur in both. Results are ordered by that count, in descending order.

Usage

duplicate_count_colpair(data, ignore = NULL, show_rates = TRUE)

Arguments

data

Data frame or matrix with at least two columns. Blank strings, "NA", and "NaN" count as missing.

ignore

Optionally, a vector of values not to count.

show_rates

Logical. If TRUE (the default), add total_x, total_y, rate_x, and rate_y; see Value. FALSE is faster.

Value

A tibble with these columns:

  • x, y: a pair of columns of data, one pair per row.

  • count: the number of values of x that also occur in y. Missing and ignored values are not counted.

  • total_x, total_y: the number of values in x and y that are neither missing nor ignored.

  • rate_x: the proportion of x values that occur in y, i.e., count / total_x, or NA if total_x is 0.

  • rate_y: the same for y. It differs from count / total_y if a value repeats within a column.

Summaries with audit()

audit() on duplicate_count_colpair() output returns summary statistics for the numeric columns.

See also

  • duplicate_count() for a frequency table.

  • duplicate_tally() for counts next to each value.

  • janitor::get_dupes() for duplicate rows.

Examples

mtcars |>
  duplicate_count_colpair()
#> # A tibble: 55 × 7
#>    x     y     count total_x total_y rate_x rate_y
#>    <chr> <chr> <int>   <int>   <int>  <dbl>  <dbl>
#>  1 cyl   carb     32      32      32 1      0.375 
#>  2 vs    am       32      32      32 1      1     
#>  3 gear  carb     27      32      32 0.844  0.406 
#>  4 vs    carb     14      32      32 0.438  0.219 
#>  5 am    carb     13      32      32 0.406  0.219 
#>  6 cyl   gear     11      32      32 0.344  0.375 
#>  7 drat  wt        3      32      32 0.0938 0.0625
#>  8 mpg   qsec      2      32      32 0.0625 0.0625
#>  9 drat  gear      1      32      32 0.0312 0.469 
#> 10 drat  carb      1      32      32 0.0312 0.0938
#> # ℹ 45 more rows

mtcars |>
  duplicate_count_colpair() |>
  audit()
#> # A tibble: 5 × 8
#>   term       mean    sd median   min   max na_count na_rate
#>   <chr>     <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>    <int>   <dbl>
#> 1 count    2.47   7.38       0     0    32        0       0
#> 2 total_x 32      0         32    32    32        0       0
#> 3 total_y 32      0         32    32    32        0       0
#> 4 rate_x   0.0773 0.231      0     0     1        0       0
#> 5 rate_y   0.0597 0.171      0     0     1        0       0
